modelingNotes: Copperhead Strike, Carowinds: procedural, CC0-1.0. bun generators/carowinds-copperhead-strike.ts (REPORT=1 for the element table)

Built with ./coaster-kit.ts, with its launches (`launches`) and inversions. Map frame: x east, y north, z up, metres; bearing 0. The origin is the middle of the footprint (ANCHOR), at the lowest ground under the track.

Plan: the OSM roller_coaster=track ways from the north end of the barn station (way/859068251), in the direction of travel: way/1190952871, 1190952873, 1190952872, 1190952875, 1190952867, 1190952870, 1190952869, 1190952868, 1190952874 (904 m round as mapped). Each loop is mapped as a zigzag (the track doubling back over the top); both are redrawn as the straight they stand on, as the kit draws the loops itself (843 m round).

Profile: a Mack double launch of 992 m (RCDB 16349, Wikipedia, Coasterpedia): a slow heartline roll out of the station and a right turn into Granny's shed; the first launch, 0 to 42 mph, out of the shed into the first vertical loop; an airtime hill, a corkscrew and a turnaround; the second launch, 35 to 50 mph, over an airtime hill that threads the second loop; the cutback, the ride's 82 ft top; a dive into the second loop; a Stengel dive; low twisting turns and a last hill into the brakes.

Photos matched (Wikimedia Commons): "A view of Copperhead Strike from Carolina Skytower", ZackyWacky, CC BY-SA 4.0 (second loop about 21 m); "Copperhead Strike 4", Jeremy Thompson, CC BY 2.0. Colours from the ThrillZing October 2024 set (CC BY 4.0): copper track, dark grey supports.

Original procedural model from https://github.com/alexwohlbruck/landmarks (catalog id "carowinds-copperhead-strike", model "carowinds-copperhead-strike"), generated by https://github.com/alexwohlbruck/landmarks/blob/c3921f733df14b41e1f6d15853cce7b343886f17/generators/carowinds-copperhead-strike.ts. That repository is the editable source; source.blend.gz is the exported mesh imported into Blender for convenience.

Exported for Open Landmarks v1: placement bearing and scale baked in; moving parts frozen in their rest pose; footings and basements below the lowest ground (y = 0) cut away; material colours carried over exactly, as library finishes where they are not standard swatches.
